**ORAL COMMUNICATIONS**
The public may address the members of the City Council on any matters within the
jurisdiction of the City Council or on any items on the agenda of the City Council ,
other than closed session matters, prior to any action taken on the agenda.
Because of the threat of COVID-19 (aka the “Coronavirus”) you are urged to take
all appropriate health safety precautions.

DUE TO CORONAVIRUS COVID-19, NO MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC WILL BE
ALLOWED INTO THE COUNCIL CHAMBERS DURING CARSON COUNCIL
MEETINGS.

TO FACILITATE PUBLIC PARTICIPATION  OUR  CARSON  CITY  COUNCIL
MEETINGS WILL BE AVAILABLE TO YOU BY:

• Livestream on the City’s website:  The meeting will be conducted live over the
internet via http://ci.carson.ca.us

•  Cable Channel 35 (Spectrum) and Channel 99 (AT&T)

Any members of the public wishing to provide public comment for the items on the
agenda may do so as follows:

1. Email:  You can email comments to cityclerk@carson.ca.us  or through the

The  public  may  address  the  members  of  the  City  Council/Housing
Authority/Successor Agency on any items on the agenda of the City
Council/Housing Authority/Successor Agency, prior to any action taken on the
agenda. Speakers shall identify themselves and the item(s) being addressed, and
are limited to no more than three minutes, speaking once (anonymous comments
will be made part of record, but not read out loud.) The three minute period may
be continued at the discretion of the presiding officer with the approval of the City
Council.  Oral communications on agendized items will be limited to one (1) hour
unless extended by order of the presiding officer with approval of the City Council.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS FOR MATTERS NOT LISTED ON THE AGENDA (MEMBERS
OF THE PUBLIC)
The public may at this time may address the members of the City Council/Housing
Authority/Successor Agency on any matters not agendized and within the
jurisdiction of the City Council/Housing Authority/Successor Agency if the one (1)
hour limit noted above has not expired, or upon order of the presiding officer with
the approval of the Council.  These items may be continued by the presiding
officer to a period later in the agenda.  No action may be taken on non-agendized
items except as authorized by law. Speakers are requested to limit their comments
to no more than three minutes, speaking once.

AGENDA ATTACHMENT A – PUBLIC PARTICIPATION OPTIONS FOR PUBLIC
HEARING ON APPEAL OF PLANNING COMMISISON DECISION ON RIR NO.
05-20 (IMPERIAL AVALON MOBILE ESTATES)

The City of Carson deeply cares for its mobile home park residents, and respects
the rights of Imperial Avalon Mobile Estates mobile home park (“Park”) residents
to participate in the public hearing on the administrative appeal of the Carson
Planning Commission’s Decision on RIR No. 05-20 related to determination of the
relocation impact mitigation measures required to be taken by the Park owner in
connection with closure of the Park.

Park residents have the following options in regards to submission of public
comments prior to the hearing, as stated in the agenda for all items on the agenda:

1. Email:  You can email comments to cityclerk@carson.ca.us, or through the
home page of the City’s website at ci.carson.ca.us, up until the meeting’s
published start time. Please identify the Agenda item you wish to address in your
comments. Your comments will be read into the record.

2. Telephone: You can record your comments at (310) 952-1720, up until the
meeting’s published start time. Please identify the Agenda item you wish to
address in your comments. Your comments will be read into the record.

3. Box outside of City Hall: You can provide hand-written comments by dropping
off a note at the box located in front of City Hall (701 East Carson Street), up until
the meeting’s published start time. Please identify the Agenda item you wish to
address in your comments. Your comments will be read into the record.

remote teleconferencing) telephonically  by calling the following number: (669)

placed on hold until the meeting begins, and the meeting administrator will
unmute and call upon residents by name when it is their turn to provide public
comment. If your name is called and there is no immediate response, the meeting

administrator will move to next public commenter and will not be obligated to

residents to observe the hearing (which will be conducted remotely using Zoom)

conditioned upon execution by each attendee of a liability waiver substantially
similar to the form attached hereto as Attachment “A-1.” To protect public health
and safety related to COVID-19, social distancing measures will be strictly
enforced, and face masks will be required for all attendees. A contactless

temperature screening will be performed at the entry; anyone with a temperature

first-served basis, and all residents who do not arrive in time to get a chair will be
required to leave. Any person who refuses to strictly adhere to these measures will
be required to leave.

The City discourages residents from exercising the in-person Community Center
participation option due to concerns regarding the spread of COVID-19, especially
in light of the recent Guidance on Closure of Sectors in Response to COVID-19
from the California Department of Public Health dated July 1, 2020, available at
https://www.cdph.ca.gov/Programs/CID/DCDC/Pages/COVID-19/Guidance-on-Clo
sure-of-Sectors-in-Response-to-COVID-19.aspx  (the  “Guidance”).  Although  the
sectors listed in the Guidance do not include gatherings such as the
aforementioned Community Center option, the Guidance provides that Los
Angeles County is on the State’s County Monitoring List, and emphasizes that the
risk of transmission of the virus is particularly high in indoor settings due to the
release of infectious particles into the air when someone speaks, coughs, sneezes,
or sings, which is exacerbated in indoor spaces particularly when lacking
appropriate ventilation.

Therefore, for the protection of your own health and the health of others, the City
strongly urges you to please seriously consider all other options for public
participation first, and to seriously consider the risks involved with the Community
Center option, before making any decision to participate in the hearing via the
Community Center option. This should be considered a last resort.

The City thanks you for your interest in this matter, and thanks you in advance for
your cooperation.
